79    /**
80     * Sets the exchange rate on the invoice if the client currency
81     * is different to the company currency.
82     */
83    public function setExchangeRate($force = false)
84    {
85        if ($this->invoice->exchange_rate != 1 || $force) {
86            return $this;
87        }
88
89        $client_currency = $this->invoice->client->getSetting('currency_id');
90        $company_currency = $this->invoice->company->settings->currency_id;
91
92        if ($company_currency != $client_currency) {
93            $exchange_rate = new CurrencyApi();
94
95            $this->invoice->exchange_rate = 1 / $exchange_rate->exchangeRate($client_currency, $company_currency, now());
96        }
97
98        return $this;
99    }

138    /**
139     * Update an invoice balance.
140     *
141     * @param  float $balance_adjustment The amount to adjust the invoice by
142     * a negative amount will REDUCE the invoice balance, a positive amount will INCREASE
143     * the invoice balance
144     *
145     * @return InvoiceService                     Parent class object
146     */
147    public function updateBalance($balance_adjustment, bool $is_draft = false)
148    {
149        if ((bool) $this->invoice->is_deleted !== false) {
150            nlog($this->invoice->number.' is deleted returning');
151
152            return $this;
153        }
154
155        $this->invoice->balance += $balance_adjustment;
156
157        if (round($this->invoice->balance, 2) == 0 && ! $is_draft) {
158            $this->invoice->status_id = Invoice::STATUS_PAID;
159        }
160
161        if ((int) $this->invoice->balance == 0) {
162            $this->invoice->next_send_date = null;
163        }
164
165        return $this;
166    }

293    public function setDueDate()
294    {
295        if ($this->invoice->due_date != '' || $this->invoice->client->getSetting('payment_terms') == '') {
296            return $this;
297        }
298
299        //12-10-2022
300        if ($this->invoice->partial > 0 && !$this->invoice->partial_due_date) {
301            $this->invoice->partial_due_date = Carbon::parse($this->invoice->date)->addDays((int)$this->invoice->client->getSetting('payment_terms'));
302        } else {
303            $this->invoice->due_date = Carbon::parse($this->invoice->date)->addDays((int)$this->invoice->client->getSetting('payment_terms'));
304        }
305
306        return $this;
307    }

309    /**
310     * Reset the reminders if only the
311     * partial has been paid.
312     *
313     * We can _ONLY_ call this _IF_ a partial
314     * amount has been paid, otherwise we end up wiping
315     * all reminders regardless
316     *
317     * @return self
318     */
319    public function checkReminderStatus(): self
320    {
321
322        if ($this->invoice->partial == 0) {
323            $this->invoice->partial_due_date = null;
324        }
325
326        if ($this->invoice->partial == 0 && $this->invoice->balance > 0) {
327            $this->invoice->reminder1_sent = null;
328            $this->invoice->reminder2_sent = null;
329            $this->invoice->reminder3_sent = null;
330
331            $this->setReminder();
332        }
333
334        return $this;
335    }

351    public function setCalculatedStatus()
352    {
353        if (round($this->invoice->balance, 2) == 0) {
354            $this->setStatus(Invoice::STATUS_PAID);
355        } elseif ($this->invoice->balance > 0 && $this->invoice->balance < $this->invoice->amount) {
356            $this->setStatus(Invoice::STATUS_PARTIAL);
357        } elseif ($this->invoice->balance < 0 || $this->invoice->balance > 0) {
358            $this->invoice->status_id = Invoice::STATUS_SENT;
359        }
360
361        return $this;
362    }
363
364    public function updateStatus()
365    {
366        if ($this->invoice->status_id == Invoice::STATUS_DRAFT) {
367            return $this;
368        }
369
370        if (round($this->invoice->balance, 2) == 0) {
371            $this->invoice->status_id = Invoice::STATUS_PAID;
372        } elseif ($this->invoice->balance > 0 && $this->invoice->balance < $this->invoice->amount) {
373            $this->invoice->status_id = Invoice::STATUS_PARTIAL;
374        } elseif ($this->invoice->balance < 0 || $this->invoice->balance > 0) {
375            $this->invoice->status_id = Invoice::STATUS_SENT;
376        }
377
378        return $this;
379    }

456    public function removeUnpaidGatewayFees()
457    {
458        $balance = $this->invoice->balance;
459
460        //return early if type three does not exist.
461        if ($this->invoice->status_id == Invoice::STATUS_PAID || ! collect($this->invoice->line_items)->contains('type_id', 3)) {
462            return $this;
463        }
464
465        $pre_count = count((array)$this->invoice->line_items);
466
467        $items = collect((array)$this->invoice->line_items)
468                    ->filter(function ($item) {
469                        return $item->type_id != '3';
470                    })->toArray();
471
472        $this->invoice->line_items = array_values($items);
473
474        $this->invoice = $this->invoice->calc()->getInvoice();
475
476        /* 24-03-2022 */
477        $new_balance = $this->invoice->balance;
478
479        $post_count = count($this->invoice->line_items);
480        nlog("pre count = {$pre_count} post count = {$post_count}");
481
482        if ((int) $pre_count != (int) $post_count) {
483            $adjustment = $balance - $new_balance;
484
485            $this->invoice
486            ->ledger()
487            ->updateInvoiceBalance($adjustment * -1, 'Adjustment for removing gateway fee');
488
489            $this->invoice->client->service()->updateBalance($adjustment * -1);
490
491        }
492
493        return $this;
494    }

513    /*When a reminder is sent we want to touch the dates they were sent*/
514    public function touchReminder(string $reminder_template)
515    {
516        nrlog(now()->format('Y-m-d h:i:s') . " INV #{$this->invoice->number} : Touching Reminder => {$reminder_template}");
517        switch ($reminder_template) {
518            case 'reminder1':
519                $this->invoice->reminder1_sent = now();
520                $this->invoice->reminder_last_sent = now();
521                $this->invoice->last_sent_date = now();
522                break;
523            case 'reminder2':
524                $this->invoice->reminder2_sent = now();
525                $this->invoice->reminder_last_sent = now();
526                $this->invoice->last_sent_date = now();
527                break;
528            case 'reminder3':
529                $this->invoice->reminder3_sent = now();
530                $this->invoice->reminder_last_sent = now();
531                $this->invoice->last_sent_date = now();
532                break;
533            case 'endless_reminder':
534                $this->invoice->reminder_last_sent = now();
535                $this->invoice->last_sent_date = now();
536                break;
537            default:
538                $this->invoice->reminder1_sent = now();
539                $this->invoice->reminder_last_sent = now();
540                $this->invoice->last_sent_date = now();
541                break;
542        }
543
544        return $this;
545    }

603        }
